watch.summary: The streamer excitedly celebrates reaching the Champion rank in Rocket League.

beats.what: Streamer screams with joy upon seeing he hit Champ rank.
Streamer continues cheering and laughing in disbelief.
Streamer claps and asks for W's in the chat.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: This clip focuses on pure energetic celebration and personal milestone achievement rather than comedy. While wholesome and fun to watch, there is no joke setup, subversion, or punchline.
